title: Custom Search-Evaluation Dataset
description: A portable, self-contained search-evaluation dataset. One homogeneous relation type per file. Any producer can author it from this contract alone; any evaluation host that accepts this contract can score it, price it from the inline demand, and report it - without the producer knowing anything about the host's internals. `built_from` is prose describing how the dataset was constructed and drives the per-term provenance label. Records carry only the required core per type; producers MAY add extra fields (e.g. `interchange`, `evidence`) and hosts read the fields they understand and ignore the rest.

type.description: The relation of each record's term to its counterpart/expected. synonym: term == counterpart (result counts stay ~same). hyponym: term is narrower than counterpart (term results are a subset; count <=). hypernym: term is broader (superset; count >=). one_to_one: term maps to exactly one expected product (retrieval check).

built_from.description: How this dataset was constructed. Human-readable; the host derives the dataset's label from it and shows it as the tooltip.

label.description: Optional short chip label. If absent, the host derives one from `type`; `built_from` is always the tooltip/explanation.

counterpart.description: Required for relational types (synonym/hypernym/hyponym): the term this record is compared against.

expected.description: Required for one_to_one: the single product the term should retrieve.

monthly_volume.description: Optional inline search demand, so impact/revenue can be computed without a separate demand pass.

interchange.description: Optional. A cross-reference / interchange identifier (or list) for this record, e.g. a competitor part number equivalent to a Cat part number.

evidence.description: Optional provenance a human can use to verify the record's relation later.

source.description: URL or file path of the document the relation was read from.
